Welcome
Welcome to our school website. At Higham, our goal is to help every child achieve their best, build confidence in their abilities, and feel safe, happy, and supported throughout their time with us. We pride ourselves on being a warm and welcoming school, and we look forward to working together to ensure both you and your child have a positive and successful experience here.

pageCache.pageTitle: Higham Primary School - Breakfast and After-School Club
pageCache.text:
Breakfast and After-School Club
Our breakfast and after-school clubs provide a safe, welcoming, and enjoyable environment for every child. We want children to feel relaxed and secure while having opportunities to play, be active, and build friendships across year group, all in a well-supervised setting.
We aim to create a positive start and finish to the school day, where children feel happy, engaged, and supported.
Activities
Our clubs offer a range of activities designed to spark creativity and encourage social interaction. Children can enjoy activities such as arts and crafts, board games, puzzles, Lego, and K’Nex. There is time for free play, allowing children to choose their own activities, and they are also invited to join in group sessions. For added variety, an Xbox is available for limited sessions, and DVDs are occasionally shown for film time. Weather permitting, children have access to an outdoor area, and during the warmer months, children can enjoy fresh air and active play with our staff in our outdoor spaces within the school grounds.
Food
We offer a range of healthy breakfast choices to children attending our breakfast club and a healthy light tea to children attending our after-school club.
Feedback
We welcome feedback from children and parents and are always keen to hear suggestions for improvement. Please feel free to get in touch!
Entrance
The club entrance is located between the two sets of gates at the front of the school. Look for the double doors with a doorbell—please ring, and our staff will greet you.
Timings
KS1 (Years R, 1, 2) - short session 3.20pm - 4.30pm (Mon - Fri), full session 3.20pm - 5.45pm (Mon-Thurs)
KS2 (Years 3, 4, 5, 6) - short session 3.30pm - 4.30pm (Mon - Fri), full session 3.20pm - 5.45pm (Mon-Thurs)
Places are limited and allocated on a first-come, first-served basis.
For full details—including pricing and booking—please see the Terms and Conditions for both clubs.
A Registration Form must be completed for all children before attending and returned to the school office or emailed to finance@higham.kent.sch.uk.
